**Issue #3556 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3556: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S10, the Mindustrial field spells
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the Mindustrial field spells: menders, projectors, reactors and overdrives.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #40 | Mender |
| #41 | Mend Projector |
| #42 | Force Projector |
| #43 | Segment |
| #55 | Thorium Reactor |
| #56 | Impact Reactor |
| #57 | Phase Weaver |
| #59 | Mass Driver |
| #62 | Overdrive Projector |
| #63 | Overdrive Dome |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E3 (#3543): Flexible.
- E4 (#3546): GIGA.
- E5 (#3548): infinite mana.
- E6 (#3550): the per-turn damage pool, and countering a Ranged attack or Activate.
- S09 (#3547): Thorium and Phase Fabric.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #40 Mender: "adjacent units" are the Units in its lane and the lanes beside it.
- #55 Thorium Reactor: the 15% is `THORIUM_REACTOR_BLOWUP_PERCENT` from the game's `Rng`, and Lucky 1 (Radiant) rerolls it once in its owner's favor. "Discard a Thorium" discards a #48 Thorium from your hand.
- #56 Impact Reactor: GIGA; then "lose 4 mana next turn and 2 the turn after"; Dormant 2; and infinite mana once awake (E5).
- #59 Mass Driver: a Field Spell with stats and Flexible. Played into a unit zone it is also a Unit (E3). "In 2 turns" adds the cards at the start of your turn two turns later.
- #62, #63 the Overdrives: "Spells gain Echo +1" adds 1 to each Spell's Echo while it is on the field (base: both players'; Radiant: yours only).

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(1) Mender, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Common, Stinkyscape+, #40**
**Flexible**
**End of turn:** Heal adjacent units to full
~~~
**Flexible**
**End of turn:** Heal adjacent units to full & give them **Divine Shield**

**(2) Mend Projector, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #41**
**End of turn:** Heal all units to full
~~~
**End of turn:** Heal all units to full & give them **Divine Shield**

**(3) Force Projector, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #42**
The first 5 damage allies would take per turn is nullified *{5 left}*
~~~
**Armor 2**
The first 10 damage allies would take per turn is nullified *{accounts for armor}* *{10 left}*

**(2) Segment, Field Trap, Mindustrial, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #43**
The first enemy **Ranged attack** or **Activate** per turn is countered *{they deal no damage, doesn’t go through}*
~~~
All enemy **Ranged attack** or **Activate** are countered *{they deal no damage, doesn’t go through}*

**(2) Thorium Reactor, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #55**
**Start of turn:** Gain 3 mana & draw 1 card
**End of turn:** 15% chance to blow up dealing 30 damage to your hero
**Activate:** Discard a **Thorium** to skip the blow up chance this turn
~~~
**Lucky 1**
**Start of turn:** Gain 3 mana & draw 1 card
**End of turn:** 15% chance to blow up dealing 30 damage to your hero
**Activate:** Discard a **Thorium** to skip the blow up chance this turn

**(3) Impact Reactor, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #56**
**GIGA**
**Cry:** lose 4 mana next turn, and 2 mana the turn after
**Dormant for 2 turns**
**When awoken:** Gain infinite mana
~~~
**GIGA**
**Cry:** lose 2 mana next turn, and 1 mana the turn after
**Dormant for 2 turns**
**When awoken:** Gain infinite mana

**(1) Phase Weaver, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #57**
**End of your turn:** add a **Phase Fabric** to your hand
~~~
**End of your turn:** add a **Phase Fabric** to your hand, it costs (0)

**(2) Mass Driver, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #59**
**Flexible**
0/6
**Activate:** in 2 turns add two **Minerals** that cost (0) and a **Resource** to your hand
~~~
**Flexible**
0/12
**Activate:** in 2 turns add two **Radiant Minerals** that cost (0) and a **Radiant Resource** to your hand

**(1) Overdrive Projector, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #62**
**Dormant for 1 turn**
All units gain **Rush** and **Windfury** and Spells gains **Echo +1**
~~~
**Dormant for 1 turn**
Your units gain **Rush** and **Windfury** and Spells gains **Echo +1**

**(2) Overdrive Dome, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #63**
**Dormant for 2 turns**
All units gain **Charge** and **Windfury** and Spell gains **Echo +2**
~~~
**Dormant for 2 turns**
Your units gain **Charge** and **Windfury** and Spell gains **Echo +2**
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3546, #3550, #3547

Part of #3534.
````
